scope: Kaby i5-8250U Qwen3 Q8_0 no-bias down-proj runtime experiment gate after SLM-CPU-197

runtime_wiring_blockers.why_blocking: The current runtime hook descriptor is sidecar-Q8 oriented and does not carry the no-bias selector identity fields required by SLM-CPU-198: model SHA, manifest SHA, role ID, layer, scope, linear, and bias_present=false.

The feed-forward callsite can derive the dense tensor name, but it does not receive a manifest-bound no-bias runtime descriptor that proves the exact Qwen3 Q8_0 down_proj role and bias evidence before compute selection.
The preflight records what would be selectable in a receipt-gated experiment, but SLM-CPU-198 requires fresh before/after strict warm-session receipts before any runtime selection is allowed.

Receipts must record dense path identity, role ID, layer, scope, linear, bias_present, selected path, selected kernel, and fallback=false for every selected no-bias role before an experiment can be audited.

required_before_runtime_selection: Add a manifest-bound no-bias runtime descriptor carrying model.sha256, quant_format, manifest_sha256, role_id, layer, scope, linear, bias_present=false, candidate_path, and candidate_kernel.
Wire FeedForward::apply_linear to consult that descriptor only when BITNET_DENSE_NO_BIAS_LINEAR_ENABLE=1 and only for exact Qwen3 Q8_0 feed_forward.down_proj layers 0..27.
Preserve eager_f32_candle and dense-f32-candle-linear as the default selected runtime and kernel.
Capture fresh paired before/after strict warm-session receipts with disabled and explicitly enabled gate states.

Prove unchanged prompt IDs or prompt ID hashes, generated IDs, decoded text, model SHA, tokenizer source/strictness, selected_backend=cpu-rust, runtime_api=cpu, fallback=false, and dense path identity.
Record role ID, layer, scope, linear, bias_present=false, manifest SHA, selected path, and selected kernel for every selected role.
Fail closed for missing, duplicate, unknown, contradictory, or bias_present=true role evidence.
claim_boundary: SLM-CPU-198 records the runtime experiment gate blocker; it does not wire normal inference to the no-bias candidate.
Normal inference still selects eager_f32_candle with dense-f32-candle-linear.
The no-bias dense-linear candidate remains disabled by default and is not executed by this slice.
The BITNET_DENSE_NO_BIAS_LINEAR_ENABLE gate is not enough by itself; runtime use also requires a manifest-bound descriptor and fresh before/after strict receipts.
No allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, Q4/Q5 runtime support, server, GPU/NPU/OpenVINO/UHD 620, Qwen3.5, or BitNet QK256 behavior is claimed.
must_not_claim: The no-bias dense linear candidate is selected by default.
Normal inference executes the no-bias candidate.
Runtime compute selection changes by default.
BITNET_DENSE_NO_BIAS_LINEAR_ENABLE alone is sufficient to select the candidate.
Generated IDs, decoded text, prompt IDs, model SHA, tokenizer source, backend/kernel identity, or fallback status are proven unchanged for a runtime experiment.
Allocation reduction, timing improvement, speedup, sustained throughput, broad decode latency, prefill latency, model-load latency, or warm-session end-to-end speedup is proven.
Q4_K_M or Q4_K_S runtime support exists.
Server, GPU, NPU, OpenVINO, or UHD 620 execution is involved.
Qwen3.5 or hybrid architecture support is in scope.
